caption: The drawing depicts two spoons rendered in shades of black and grey pencil on a beige background. The upper spoon is illustrated from a top-down perspective, showing an oval bowl, a long handle with subtle tapering in the middle, and a rounded-end handle tip that displays a monogram or decorative script character resembling the letter "A." The lower spoon is drawn in profile from the side, showing the same basic proportions and form as the upper spoon, with a gently curved handle and the bowl facing to the left. title: Silver Teaspoon
